_source: Core Rulebook, Cleric: Domains (d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/cleric/domains/paizo-domains). The numbers are the ones content/domains/powers.json already carries for these powers; this file adds what using one DOES. A druid with the domain through nature bond uses her druid level (Core Rulebook, Nature Bond).
_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. `power` is the key in content/domains/powers.json; a character has the ability exactly when `domains.powers_had` lists that power, and spends the pool that file already defines.

abilities.name: Lightning Arc
abilities.source: Air domain: a standard action, a ranged touch attack at a foe within 30 ft, 1d6 electricity + 1 per two cleric levels; 3 + Wis times a day.
abilities.text: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d6 electricity + 1 per two levels.

abilities.name: Acid Dart
abilities.source: Earth domain: a standard action, a ranged touch attack at a foe within 30 ft, 1d6 acid + 1 per two cleric levels; 3 + Wis times a day.
abilities.text: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d6 acid + 1 per two levels.

abilities.name: Fire Bolt
abilities.source: Fire domain: a standard action, a ranged touch attack at a foe within 30 ft, 1d6 fire + 1 per two cleric levels; 3 + Wis times a day.
abilities.text: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d6 fire + 1 per two levels.

abilities.name: Icicle
abilities.source: Water domain: a standard action, a ranged touch attack at a foe within 30 ft, 1d6 cold + 1 per two cleric levels; 3 + Wis times a day.
abilities.text: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d6 cold + 1 per two levels.

abilities.name: Storm Burst
abilities.source: Weather domain: a standard action, a ranged touch attack at a foe within 30 ft, 1d6 nonlethal + 1 per two cleric levels, and the target takes -2 on attack rolls for 1 round; 3 + Wis times a day.
abilities.text: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d6 nonlethal + 1 per two levels, and -2 to its attacks for a round.
abilities.tell: {name} calls a burst of wind and rain.

abilities.name: Wooden Fist
abilities.source: Plant domain: a free action, for 3 + Wis rounds a day: unarmed strikes deal lethal damage, provoke no attack of opportunity, and add +1 per two cleric levels (minimum +1) to damage.
abilities.text: Fists hard as wood: + half your level to unarmed damage (min +1), a round a round.
not_yet: Lethal unarmed damage without the -4, and no attack of opportunity for striking unarmed: neither rides the stance yet.
